arguments.query: select b.*, (select group_concat(charge_id||":"||idempotency_key||":"||state) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b where status!="confirmed"

select b.booking_id,b.status,(select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) nc,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) nh,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) nk from bookings b where status!="confirmed" or nk=0
select status,count(*) n from outbox group by status

select b.booking_id,b.status,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(state||":"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) nh,(select count(*) from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) nk,(select group_concat(status) from outbox o where o.booking_id=b.booking_id) ob from bookings b where b.status!="confirmed" or nk=0 or nh=0 or (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id)!=1 order by rowid desc limit 20
select service,path,status,message,count(*) n,max(rowid) last from request_logs where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4 order by last desc limit 12

select (select count(*) from refunds) r,(select group_concat(booking_id||amount_cents) from refunds) rr,(select count(*) from charges where state not in ("captured","declined")) np,(select count(*) from customer_events) ce,(select count(*) from bookings where status="pending") pb,(select count(*) from outbox where status="pending") op
select client_reference,count(*) n,group_concat(status) s from bookings where client_reference is not null group by 1 having n>1
